name: amazon_review_followup
method: Read-only release Flight SQL. Charging mentions are case-insensitive charg substring matches in title plus text, among all reviews rated at most two in each year. No embedding, text-length, or verified-purchase filter. This is a separate keyword check; it does not reproduce or relabel the earlier fitted KMeans cluster.

charging.name: amazon-charging
charging.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM review_time) AS review_year,
       COUNT(*) AS low_rating_reviews,
       SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(text, '')) LIKE '%charg%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charging_mentions
FROM reviews
WHERE product_id = 1507685 AND rating <= 2
  AND review_time >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
  AND review_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM review_time)
ORDER BY review_year;

reviews.name: amazon-charging-reviews
reviews.sql:
SELECT review_id, review_time, rating, title, text
FROM reviews
WHERE product_id = 1507685 AND rating <= 2
  AND review_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
  AND review_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(text, '')) LIKE '%charg%'
ORDER BY review_id
LIMIT 5;

eligible.name: amazon-eligible
eligible.sql:
WITH review_history AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS reviews_2022,
         AVG(CASE WHEN rating <= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS low_rating_share
  FROM reviews
  WHERE review_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
    AND review_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01' AND verified_purchase
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_products
FROM products p
JOIN review_history h ON h.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category_l3 = 'Headphones & Earbuds'
  AND p.price BETWEEN 20 AND 150
  AND h.reviews_2022 >= 100 AND h.low_rating_share <= 0.20;
